primary.thesis: XPL (Plasma) peaked at around $1.6-1.7 just after its September 2025 launch, then fell hard. By the start of the window on Nov 24, 2025 it was roughly in the low $0.20s. From there it faced heavy supply overhang: ecosystem incentive emissions, the US public-sale unlock around mid-2026, and team and investor cliff unlocks starting around September 2026. Its main selling point, zero-fee USDT transfers, can be copied by competing stablecoin chains such as Stable, Arc and Tempo, and by Tron. That leaves little reason for new buyers to push the price up 5-8x. The likely path is a token stuck in a range: it may touch the lowest rungs on relief rallies, but it never gets back near its launch highs. The high rungs resolve NO. The mid rungs ($0.50-0.60) would need a sustained rally of more than 2x against the unlock pressure, which is also unlikely.

basket.reason: $1.20 is about 5x the level at the window start and close to the post-launch highs. That would need a full re-rating while unlocks are adding supply.
$1.60 is near or at the all-time high from launch. Retesting it would take a major new catalyst that the token's design does not supply.
$0.50 needs more than a 2x recovery from the late-2025 base. A range capped by emissions and unlocks should keep the 1-minute highs below that level.
$0.24 is only a small move above the late-November 2025 price. Any relief bounce or single-candle spike over the 13-month window hits it.

failure_narrative: The basket loses if a broad crypto risk-on wave arrives in 2026, driven by Fed cuts, strong ETF inflows and an altcoin season, and at the same time stablecoin payments become a hot story. Examples would be USDT supply growth, a US stablecoin law being implemented, or Tether/Bitfinex openly routing volume through Plasma. XPL then gets re-rated as the stablecoin-chain beta trade and a short squeeze takes it through $0.50, and possibly $1.20+. The other way to lose is the C11 leg: XPL keeps bleeding from Nov 24, 2025 and never prints a 1-minute high of $0.24 on Binance.
hedge_thesis: In the worlds where XPL rallies hard, the whole crypto market will almost certainly be in a liquidity-driven bull phase. A small-cap token with ongoing unlocks does not rise 3-5x on its own story; it needs the market-wide flow that also lifts BTC, ETH and the large-cap L1s. That flow would come from easier dollar conditions (Fed cuts, a weaker dollar, strong spot ETF inflows) plus growing stablecoin supply, especially USDT, which Plasma's volume depends on. So a view that BTC/ETH/SOL make new highs, and that USDT market cap and ETF inflows accelerate in 2026, pays off in exactly the worlds where the XPL NO legs fail.
